transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I think what really made me come in is that I’ve started losing my place a lot at work. I'm a receptionist, and lately, while I’m scheduling appointments or working on the lobby displays, my mind just sort of... slips off track. It's like I can't focus on the task right in front of me because I’m too busy thinking about what else I might have overlooked or forgotten to do.
When your mind slips off track, are you mainly worrying about many different things that feel difficult to control?

Yeah, that's pretty much it. It's definitely hard to control. I mean, I can tell myself, 'Sunny, it's handled,' but the thought just keeps looping anyway. And then, well, pretty soon I've gone from that one concern to another, until I'm just checking all these little details in my head over and over.
How long have you been experiencing this pattern of excessive, difficult-to-control worry?

Well, it's been about nine months now. It all started right after... well, I had an overnight detention, and there was a big paperwork mix-up around it. Ever since that happened, it's just been going on like this.
Are your worries mainly about the detention and paperwork incident, or do they also involve many other areas of your life?

No, it's not just about the detention anymore. It's... it's kind of spilled over into everything else. I find myself worrying about all kinds of ordinary things now. Like work schedules, paying the bills, travel plans, or even just making little paperwork errors at the front desk. It's as if I feel like one small mix-up could turn into a much bigger problem, so I just keep worrying about all of it.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, I have. Most nights I get into bed feeling really tired, but then... I just lie there. I end up going over tomorrow's appointments in my head, or worrying about some form I might have missed at the front desk. And even when I finally do get to sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down or got any actual rest.
